note: Export direction is confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code: the company ships machine knives, shear blades, slitting-machine spacers and circular saw blanks to Italy, Malaysia, UAE, China and the USA, latest record 2026-02-28. Declared HS 845530 (rolling-mill rolls) does not match the observed codes (84669400, 84669390, 82022000 — parts of metalworking machinery / saw blades); per project rule this is not a rejection ground, the actual HS should be corrected to the observed codes and the verdict kept as accepted_hs_corrected. Note the ImportKey page mixes directions: the 'Suppliers' block (Shandong Qilu, Asianet Metals, Dongbei Special Steel, SIJ Metal Ravne) shows inbound steel purchases, so the company is a manufacturer that both imports raw steel and exports finished tooling. Caveat on the counter: ImportKey reports 6859 total shipments but only 5 rows were visible on the free view, so the 6859 figure is the site's own counter and was not independently verified row-by-row. Volza, Eximpedia and Trademo returned HTTP 403 and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable during this run, so no second source could be cross-checked. Domestic supply evidence remains unverified (null).
